items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: that was where I first heard Lips Page and Roy Eldridge; they had a jam session there, and I sat in there.

ctx.x: And I asked if I could sit in, and they looked at me, because at that time, I only weighed 121 lbs; I was the littlest guy, and I looked like I was about 14 years old.

So they asked me how old I was, so I told them I was 18, but I said I'd be 19 in December --and this was August. So they said, "And you can play?" -- and I said, "I think so." So I got up on the bandstand and I started playing, and everybody started looking around at me, and I played the same thing when I went to Jocks and the same at the Rennie.
